merits.name: Acute Sense
merits.summary: One sense is exceptionally sharp, lowering related task difficulties.

merits.name: Ambidextrous
merits.summary: Your off-hand works without the usual penalty.

merits.name: Bruiser
merits.summary: Your presence suggests violence and helps Intimidation.

merits.name: Catlike Balance
merits.summary: Balance-related rolls are notably easier for you.

merits.name: Early Riser
merits.summary: You wake earlier in the evening than most vampires.

merits.name: Eat Food
merits.summary: You can keep down food long enough to pass as mortal.

merits.name: Friendly Face
merits.summary: Strangers tend to trust you on first meeting.

merits.name: Blush of Health
merits.summary: You appear more warm and alive than most Kindred.

merits.name: Enchanting Voice
merits.summary: Voice-based persuasion, charm, and command are easier.

merits.name: Daredevil
merits.summary: You thrive on dangerous stunts and survive them more often.

merits.name: Efficient Digestion
merits.summary: Feeding yields extra blood pool from the same amount of blood.

merits.name: Huge Size
merits.summary: You are abnormally large and gain extra mass and resilience.

merits.name: Coldly Logical
merits.summary: You separate facts from emotion more easily than most.

merits.name: Common Sense
merits.summary: The Storyteller can warn you away from obviously foolish decisions.

merits.name: Concentration
merits.summary: Distractions interfere with you less than usual.

merits.name: Introspection
merits.summary: You read motives, especially from similar personalities, with unusual clarity.

merits.name: Language
merits.summary: You know an additional language.

merits.name: Time Sense
merits.summary: You judge the passage of time accurately without instruments.

merits.name: Useful Knowledge
merits.summary: A specialized field of knowledge attracts patronage from interested Kindred.

merits.name: Code of Honor
merits.summary: Acting within your personal code strengthens Willpower and Virtue rolls.

merits.name: Computer Aptitude
merits.summary: Computer-related tasks are significantly easier for you.

merits.name: Eidetic Memory
merits.summary: You remember sights and sounds with near-perfect detail.

merits.name: Light Sleeper
merits.summary: You wake instantly and function better during the day.

merits.name: Natural Linguist
merits.summary: Languages come easily and the Language Merit gives you more.

merits.name: Calm Heart
merits.summary: Resisting frenzy comes more easily to you.

merits.name: Iron Will
merits.summary: Mental domination and similar powers face strong resistance from you.

merits.name: Precocious
merits.summary: Chosen Abilities are learned faster and more cheaply.

merits.name: Elysium Regular
merits.summary: You are a familiar face in Elysium and the local social scene.

merits.name: Former Ghoul
merits.summary: Your prior exposure to vitae makes vampiric society easier to navigate.

merits.name: Harmless
merits.summary: Others underestimate you and often leave you alone.

merits.name: Natural Leader
merits.summary: You inspire others to follow when you take charge.

merits.name: Prestigious Sire
merits.summary: Your sire's reputation still benefits you.

merits.name: Protégé
merits.summary: Your sire spoke well of you before your Embrace.

merits.name: Rep
merits.summary: Your name travels farther than your immediate circle.

merits.name: Sabbat Survivor
merits.summary: You are sharper to Sabbat dangers after surviving one before.

merits.name: Boon
merits.summary: A vampire of some standing owes you a favor.

merits.name: Bullyboy
merits.summary: You are muscle for local authority and get access others miss.

merits.name: Old Pal
merits.summary: A trusted associate from mortal life was Embraced with you.

merits.name: Lawman's Friend
merits.summary: A sheriff or bishop is inclined to overlook your smaller mistakes.

merits.name: Open Road
merits.summary: You know how to travel between cities more safely than most Kindred.

merits.name: Sanctity
merits.summary: Others tend to see you as pure, trustworthy, or harmless.

merits.name: Scholar of Enemies
merits.summary: You know one enemy group's habits, tactics, and culture well.

merits.name: Scholar of Others
merits.summary: You know one outside group's customs, politics, and goals well.

merits.name: Friend of the Underground
merits.summary: You know the local subterranean world and how to move through it.

merits.name: Mole
merits.summary: You have an informant inside an enemy organization.

merits.name: Rising Star
merits.summary: Your status is climbing and others treat you accordingly.

merits.name: Broken Bond
merits.summary: You slipped a blood bond without your former regnant noticing.

merits.name: Clan Friendship
merits.summary: One clan treats you far more kindly than usual.

merits.name: Primogen/Bishop Friendship
merits.summary: The city's ruling vampires value your counsel.

merits.name: Deceptive Aura
merits.summary: Your aura reads more like a mortal's than a vampire's.

merits.name: Healing Touch
merits.summary: You can close feeding wounds with a touch.

merits.name: Inoffensive to Animals
merits.summary: Animals tolerate your presence rather than recoiling from it.

merits.name: Medium
merits.summary: You can hear and sense ghosts and other dead spirits.

merits.name: Magic Resistance
merits.summary: Blood sorcery and similar magic have a harder time affecting you.

merits.name: Hidden Diablerie
merits.summary: Your aura does not show the usual stains of diablerie.

merits.name: Lucky
merits.summary: A few failed rolls per story can be retried.

merits.name: Oracular Ability
merits.summary: You perceive omens and sometimes interpret what they mean.

merits.name: Spirit Mentor
merits.summary: A ghostly guide can sometimes aid or advise you.

merits.name: True Love
merits.summary: A mortal love still anchors your will in the World of Darkness.

merits.name: Additional Discipline
merits.summary: You gain one additional Discipline as though it were in-clan.

merits.name: Unbondable
merits.summary: You cannot be blood bound.

merits.name: Nine Lives
merits.summary: Fate repeatedly spares you from death, until it finally doesn't.

merits.name: True Faith
merits.summary: A profound faith empowers Willpower and Virtue with miraculous force.

flaws.name: Hard of Hearing
flaws.summary: Hearing-based rolls are harder for you.

flaws.name: Short
flaws.summary: Your unusually small stature limits reach and speed.

flaws.name: Smell of the Grave
flaws.summary: You smell of damp earth and unsettle nearby mortals.

flaws.name: Tic/Twitch
flaws.summary: A stress-triggered motion makes you easier to identify.

flaws.name: Bad Sight
flaws.summary: Sight-based tasks are harder for you without corrective aid.

flaws.name: Disfigured
flaws.summary: A memorable deformity makes social interaction much harder.

flaws.name: Dulled Bite
flaws.summary: Feeding is harder because your fangs are weak or absent.

flaws.name: Infectious Bite
flaws.summary: Your bites may sicken mortals after you feed on them.

flaws.name: One Eye
flaws.summary: Depth perception and many sight-based tasks suffer.

flaws.name: Vulnerability to Silver
flaws.summary: Silver burns and wounds you like a supernatural bane.

flaws.name: Open Wound
flaws.summary: A wound refuses to heal cleanly and leaks blood each night.

flaws.name: Addiction
flaws.summary: You require a substance in the blood you drink.

flaws.name: Child
flaws.summary: Your undeveloped body makes physical force and adult authority harder.

flaws.name: Deformity
flaws.summary: A significant bodily defect hinders action and social ease.

flaws.name: Glowing Eyes
flaws.summary: Your eyes reveal your nature and complicate stealth.

flaws.name: Lame
flaws.summary: You cannot run and walk only with major impairment.

flaws.name: Lazy
flaws.summary: Unplanned exertion is harder because you avoid effort.

flaws.name: Monstrous
flaws.summary: Your body reflects the Beast and your Appearance is ruined.

flaws.name: Permanent Fangs
flaws.summary: Your fangs never retract and constantly threaten the Masquerade.

flaws.name: Permanent Wound
flaws.summary: You rise each night already wounded from an unhealed injury.

flaws.name: Slow Healing
flaws.summary: Damage costs more blood and more time to recover from.

flaws.name: Disease Carrier
flaws.summary: Your blood spreads a severe contagious disease.

flaws.name: Deaf
flaws.summary: You cannot hear at all.

flaws.name: Mute
flaws.summary: You cannot speak and must communicate another way.

flaws.name: Thin Blood
flaws.summary: Your vitae is weak and all blood-fueled functions cost more.

flaws.name: Flesh of the Corpse
flaws.summary: Visible injuries never fade fully from your body.

flaws.name: Infertile Vitae
flaws.summary: Your blood can never create childer.

flaws.name: Blind
flaws.summary: You cannot see and must navigate the world by other senses.

flaws.name: Deep Sleeper
flaws.summary: Waking during the day is much harder for you.

flaws.name: Impatient
flaws.summary: Waiting quietly tests your self-control.

flaws.name: Nightmares
flaws.summary: Day sleep leaves you shaken and less capable at night.

flaws.name: Prey Exclusion
flaws.summary: You refuse to feed from a chosen category of prey.

flaws.name: Shy
flaws.summary: Social interaction with strangers is harder for you.

flaws.name: Soft-Hearted
flaws.summary: Causing suffering requires a strong act of will.

flaws.name: Speech Impediment
flaws.summary: Verbal communication is notably more difficult.

flaws.name: Unconvinced
flaws.summary: Your sect or clan doubts your loyalty to its ideals.

flaws.name: Amnesia
flaws.summary: Your own past is largely missing and may return dangerously.

flaws.name: Lunacy
flaws.summary: Moon phases worsen your risk of frenzy.

flaws.name: Phobia
flaws.summary: A particular fear can drive you into retreat or panic.

flaws.name: Short Fuse
flaws.summary: Avoiding frenzy is harder because you anger too quickly.

flaws.name: Stereotype
flaws.summary: You lean into cartoon vampire behavior and embarrass other Kindred.

flaws.name: Territorial
flaws.summary: You react violently to intruders in your chosen domain.

flaws.name: Thirst for Innocence
flaws.summary: Innocence itself triggers your hunger.

flaws.name: Vengeful
flaws.summary: Revenge overrides your judgment when the target appears.

flaws.name: Victim of the Masquerade
flaws.summary: You still refuse to fully believe you are a vampire.

flaws.name: Weak-Willed
flaws.summary: Dominate and intimidation work on you far too easily.

flaws.name: Conspicuous Consumption
flaws.summary: Feeding requires you to consume flesh as well as blood.

flaws.name: Guilt-Wracked
flaws.summary: Feeding fills you with guilt severe enough to trigger frenzy.

flaws.name: Flashbacks
flaws.summary: Trauma causes severe and unpredictable collapses in Willpower.

flaws.name: Dark Secret
flaws.summary: A hidden truth could destroy your standing if exposed.

flaws.name: Enemy
flaws.summary: A dangerous foe actively works against you.

flaws.name: Infamous Sire
flaws.summary: Your sire's reputation poisons how others view you.

flaws.name: Cast No Reflection
flaws.summary: You cast no reflection and invite dangerous questions.

flaws.name: Cold Breeze
flaws.summary: An unnatural chill follows you and unsettles mortals.

flaws.name: Repulsed by Garlic
flaws.summary: Garlic drives you away unless you force yourself to endure it.

flaws.name: Touch of Frost
flaws.summary: Plants die and warmth leeches away under your touch.

flaws.name: Cursed
flaws.summary: A supernatural curse twists part of your existence.

flaws.name: Beacon of the Unholy
flaws.summary: The devout instinctively sense something wrong in you.

flaws.name: Deathsight
flaws.summary: The world appears rotten and dead, hindering perception and social ease.

flaws.name: Eerie Presence
flaws.summary: Mortals instinctively fear your undead nature.

flaws.name: Lord of the Flies
flaws.summary: A cloud of decay-hungry insects follows you and ruins stealth.

flaws.name: Can't Cross Running Water
flaws.summary: Old folklore binds you away from flowing water.

flaws.name: Haunted
flaws.summary: A tormented ghost dogs your steps and tries to make you suffer.

flaws.name: Repelled by Crosses
flaws.summary: Ordinary crosses can drive you back in terror.

flaws.name: Grip of the Damned
flaws.summary: Feeding brings only terror and pain to your victims.

flaws.name: Dark Fate
flaws.summary: You are doomed to a terrible end and sometimes glimpse it in advance.

flaws.name: Light-Sensitive
flaws.summary: Sunlight and even moonlight injure you more than normal.
